en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of an old rural house with stone walls and a tiled roof. In front of the house, there are large piles of cut branches, some trees, and scattered farm animals such as chickens and geese. The house appears to be traditional in style, with multiple chimneys and small windows. The text on the image is in Spanish and printed in red ink at the top left.
